capabilities: upload clipboard images to Qiniu Cloud
embed the uploaded image in the note
configure a Qiniu bucket, access keys and external link domain
set optional name prefix and time format for uploaded files
extras: README credits the Obsidian Image Auto Upload Plugin and Obsidian Imgur Plugin under a Thanks section but does not state how it relates to them.
problem: Obsidian stores pasted images locally in the vault, which grows the vault size; this plugin uploads them to Qiniu Cloud instead.

relations.evidence: uploads the images to Qiniu Cloud instead of storing them locally in your vault

summary: Clipboard image uploader that sends pasted images to Qiniu Cloud storage and embeds the uploaded image link in the note.
